performance_case.causal_mechanism: A complete UTC-day BTC move of at least 3 percent may create direction-conditioned next-day liquidity normalization or continuation, measured only after a complete untouched h24 outcome. This task audits whether the frozen V1/V2 evaluator can test that mechanism without lineage mixing or post-outcome tuning.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive result proves only offline acceptance of the already committed post-shock continuation/reversal evaluator, its missed-window rollover lineage, exact schemas, formulas, breadth and concentration gates, current heartbeat child ordering and deterministic tests. It proves no normal rollover, deployment activation, forward episode, prediction, causality, significance, strategy mapping, fee-adjusted PnL, drawdown, costs, capacity, candidate, OOS, deployability or Trading value and authorizes no write or execution.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any later drawdown claim requires a separately preregistered spot-feasible matched-capital experiment after untouched forward evidence selects at most one mechanism; no strategy or economic ledger is evaluated here.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Closing the exact offline acceptance gap prevents an already implemented evaluator from remaining scientifically untrusted or being reimplemented after outcomes. A rejection stops use at the concrete failed proof; a positive result lets the normal single-clock rollover collect evidence without adding another tool, timer or writer.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted total PnL effect is zero. The only present value is lower learning latency and stronger leakage, lineage and gate integrity for one pre-registered forward diagnostic.
